claims.evidence: Witness photos show a large industrial machine/engine-like unit inside a white cargo van; no clear 3-wheel trike/motorbike, brand, or model is readable.
No customs/duty documents are shown in the witness report.
No tyres/wheels are shown clearly in the witness photos; the visible items are loose parts around an engine-like unit.
No tamper indicators, serials, or inspection marks are shown; the report only notes used appearance/dust in the van.
No purchase date/receipt or identifying labels are shown.

claims.claim: Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No functional test (gears/brakes) is shown; rust/originality cannot be confirmed from the reported photo angle.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch: the witness photos appear to show an industrial engine-like machine, not a 3-wheel trike motorbike.
risks.proof: A clear exterior photo of the full 3-wheel trike (front, side, and rear) showing wheels/tyres and any brand/model badges, plus a close-up of the VIN/serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used industrial machine/engine-like unit (not a motorbike) with incomplete/uncertain parts and no confirmed working status.

risks.risk: Completeness risk: loose parts scattered in the van may indicate missing components or non-included accessories.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing every included part with labels, and a photo of the machine assembled/complete (no loose parts left out).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete (missing accessories/manuals/parts) and treat as higher risk for additional spend.

risks.risk: Working condition risk: no evidence of running/tested status; dust/debris suggests used condition and possible faults.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the unit/trike being started and running (or a brake/gear test for the trike), including a sound/idle and any dashboard indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Damage/corrosion risk not visible from the reported angle (cracks, missing panels, corrosion, bent parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of critical areas: frame welds, engine casing, mounting points, and any visible corrosion spots from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for cosmetic/structural wear consistent with used goods.

risks.risk: Specification/compatibility risk (power/fuel/voltage for the machine; or for a trike: engine size, tyre size, parts compatibility).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the specification plate/engine label (voltage/fuel/engine code) and tyre size markings; plus dimensions for transport.
risks.if_unproven: Price with compatibility uncertainty (harder to service/fit) and assume buyer may need parts/repairs.

risks.risk: Documentation/legality risk: customs/duty claim not evidenced.
risks.proof: Photos/scans of customs/duty documents (bill of entry, duty receipt) and any import paperwork tied to the serial/VIN.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no documentation available (higher buyer risk and potential inability to register/claim).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the complete 3-wheel trike (front/side/rear) showing wheels/tyres and any Ryker/brand/model markings.
Provide close-up photos of the VIN/serial plate and engine code label.
Send a video of the trike starting and a short ride/brake test (or gears test) showing it works.
Show an itemized inventory of all included parts (especially the loose parts seen in the van) and confirm nothing is missing.
Provide customs/duty documents (bill of entry and duty receipt) linked to the serial/VIN.
Send close-ups of tyres (tread condition and tyre size markings) and frame/engine for rust/damage checks.
Provide transport dimensions/weight and any service history/receipt from the claimed purchase date.
response.reason: The witness photos do not clearly match the seller’s claim of a 3-wheel Ryker trike; key details needed to price correctly (identity, completeness, and working condition) are missing or unverifiable from the reported images.
